validation_queries.description: ROCPROFSYS_KOKKOSP_DEEP_COPY emits one region per Kokkos::deep_copy, named '<prefix> <dst space> <- <src name> [deep_copy]'. Match the ' [deep_copy]' suffix, not the substring 'deep_copy': Kokkos names several of its own fences 'Kokkos::deep_copy: ... [fence]' and those are recorded with the flag off too
validation_queries.error_message: No '[deep_copy]' regions recorded; ROCPROFSYS_KOKKOSP_DEEP_COPY did not enable Kokkos deep-copy tracking
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_string WHERE string LIKE '% [deep_copy]'

validation_queries.description: The deep-copy names must be attached to real timed regions, not just interned as strings
validation_queries.error_message: '[deep_copy]' strings exist but no region uses them; deep-copy tracking interned the names without recording the copies
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM regions WHERE name LIKE '% [deep_copy]'
